caption:
Every lead has a price tag on how fast you call it back.

The Missed Revenue Calculator puts a number on it for your business, not an industry average.

Enter your monthly leads, close rate, average job value, and current response time.

It maps your revenue per lead, the follow-up gap your speed is creating, and what a 10% faster response could add over a year.

Four inputs. Your pipeline, your numbers.
